messages:
Ana Chen: quick heads-up — PR #4823 updates the SDK snippets for streaming + pagination. I noticed the py example still uses the old cursor API. Can someone sanity-check?
Mike R.: looking now. main change is iterator -> async generator plus the retry example needs explicit backoff.
Leo Vargas: FYI the TypeScript snippet also drops `autoPaginate` and uses `paginateStream`. I left a TODO in the PR to add a small TS example for manual cursor handling.
Tia Patel: pinging @Mike R. and @Leo — we should keep all three langs consistent (py/ts/go) and show the streaming case with retry-on-EOF. Also need a short migration note.
Mike R.: agreed. I'll patch the PY snippet to use `async for chunk in client.stream(...):` and show the retry wrapper. Quick draft: ```python
# pseudo
from backoff import expo
@expo()
async def fetch():
    async for part in client.stream("/generate", prompt):
        print(part)
```
Leo Vargas: nice. For TS I'll add something like: `for await (const msg of client.streamGenerator(req)) { /* handle */ }` and show a 3-retry with exponential backoff util.
DocsBot: Reminder: docs link checker will run on merge; please avoid raw GitHub links in snippets, use relative permalinks. :memo:
Tia Patel: small nit — include a one-liner in each snippet about when to use prefix caching vs full streaming. Helps customers understand latency vs cost tradeoff.
Ana Chen: good call. Also add a changelog entry under "SDK snippets" and a note in the migration guide (breaking: iterator -> async generator).
Mike R.: I pushed a follow-up commit with the py snippet + comment about caching. PR now includes tests that run a tiny mock stream. Can someone review? -> https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/4823
Leo Vargas: reviewing now. I'll add Go snippet after merging TS to mirror behavior.
Tia Patel: once merged I'll trigger the docs build and run link-check. If all green, we can cut a small release note. :rocket:
